classification: trainability addendum to the completed exploratory paper-facing degree-six objective experiment

problem.objective: 6150 frozen products of six binary variables with independent Uniform[-0.5, 0.5] weights
problem.stage1_checkpoint: the exact frozen p1=12 checkpoint used in the completed paper-facing experiment

pilot.role: runtime, memory, and numerical-stability validation only

confirmation.role: the exact six fresh frozen confirmation instances used in the completed SPSA experiment

initialization_points.random: method-neutral common objective-angle and mixer-angle streams; the separated-angle method receives one additional independent conflict-angle stream
initialization_points.deterministic_linear_ramp: the same ramp form used by the optimizer implementation
initialization_points.paper_history_identity: identity embedding of the immediately preceding optimized SPSA solution
initialization_points.paper_history_interpolation: linear interpolation of the immediately preceding optimized SPSA solution
initialization_points.paper_final: the selected final SPSA angles from the exact completed paper-facing trial

exact_gradient_observables.shared_final_objective: the exact expected 6150-term final objective for every method
exact_gradient_observables.target_a_log_probability: the exact gradient of log(Target-A probability)
normalization: training-loss RMS divided by the full-shell standard deviation of the method-native Hamiltonian
final-objective RMS divided by the full-shell standard deviation of the shared final objective
alignment: cosine between the native training-loss gradient and final-objective gradient
cosine between conflict and final-objective gradients
cosine between native descent and increasing Target-A log-probability

precision.audit_scope: pilot seed 900, depths 26 and 32, deterministic ramp plus two random points per primary configuration
precision.interpretation: the complex64 result is accepted only if finite and not pinned to its numerical floor; discrepancies are reported rather than silently discarded

claim_limits.fixed_N: This addendum tests depth-dependent conditioning at N=30; it does not by itself prove or disprove exponential barren-plateau scaling with N.
claim_limits.gradient_evidence: Optimization performance and SPSA finite-difference traces are kept distinct from exact autodifferentiated gradient evidence.
